title: Face2Face: Real-time Face Capture and Reenactment of RGB Videos (CVPR 2016 Oral)
summary: The CVPR 2016 oral demo of Face2Face, a system that captures a person's face and reenacts another video's face in real time using only RGB video. The authors frame it as research on modern vision and graphics.
why: HN uses it as a reference point in deepfake and fake-news discussions, showing that convincing real-time video manipulation was already possible in 2016.

quote.text: The face2face[1] tech looks pretty convincing to me and it already works in real-time
